With level 6 Runecrafting, mist runes can be crafted in two ways:
• Pure essence, water runes and a water talisman to the air altar.
• Pure essence, air runes and an air talisman to the water altar.
Players must use the talisman on the altar. Tiaras can't be used in place of talismans while crafting combination runes. Players receive 8.0 experience for combining water runes at the air altar and 8.5 for combining air runes at the water altar.

• Received from Menaphite gift offerings
